title: agent-kit readiness result
description: What the assess-readiness skill returns. The runner saves it to .workflow/state/readiness.json with a hash of brief/, docs/ and tasks/.

status.description: READY requires zero critical, major and unresolved_decisions counts and an empty decisions array.

unresolved_decisions.description: Must equal the number of entries in decisions.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences: the scope and the main risks.

decisions.description: Open decisions a person must make before coding starts.
